6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Tangent.TruncExpCech
7	
8	/-!
9	# Iso-transport of the two-chart Čech coboundary subgroup
10	
11	`TruncExpCech.cechCoboundaryUnits ρ₁ ρ₂ ≤ Bˣ` (`Tangent/TruncExpCech.lean`) is the
12	coboundary subgroup `im(ρ₁ˣ) · im(ρ₂ˣ)` of a two-chart datum of ring homomorphisms
13	`ρ₁ : A₁ →+* B`, `ρ₂ : A₂ →+* B`.  This file records that it is **natural in the datum**:
14	an isomorphism of two-chart data — ring isomorphisms `α₁, α₂, β` making both restriction
15	squares commute — carries coboundaries to coboundaries, so `Units.map β` restricts to an
16	isomorphism of the coboundary subgroups and descends to the Čech `Ȟ¹`-of-units quotients.
17	
18	## Why this is here
19	
20	The algebra-side ℙ¹ coboundary theory (`Picard/LaurentTwoChartCoboundary.lean` and the
21	`Algebra/Laurent*` files) characterises `laurentCoboundaryUnits A`, the coboundary subgroup
22	of the **abstract** two-chart datum `Polynomial.toLaurent`, `rightChart` on
23	`(LaurentPolynomial A)ˣ`.  A scheme consumer instead holds
24	`Scheme.twoChartCoboundaryUnits`, the coboundary subgroup of the **scheme** restriction homs
25	`X.resHom` on `Γ(X, V₀ ⊓ V₁)ˣ` (`Picard/TwoChartCechPicTrivial.lean`).  On the two charts of
26	a relative curve `ℙ¹_A` these two data are isomorphic once one identifies
27	`Γ(V₀), Γ(V₁), Γ(V₀ ⊓ V₁)` with `A[t], A[t], A[T;T⁻¹]` and the restrictions with the two
28	Laurent chart maps.  This file is the transport that turns *that identification of data*
29	into a transport of the *coboundary conclusion*, with no new hypothesis and no dependence
30	on the identifying isomorphisms being anything in particular.
31	
32	`cechCoboundaryUnits` is a `sup` of two `Units.map`-ranges, so the whole content is the
33	naturality of a `Units.map`-range under a commuting square, done once here rather than
34	inlined at each application.
35	
36	## Main declarations
37	
38	* `TruncExpCech.cechCoboundaryUnits_map_le` — `Units.map β` sends `cechCoboundaryUnits ρ₁ ρ₂`
39	  into `cechCoboundaryUnits ρ₁' ρ₂'` when `β ∘ ρᵢ = ρᵢ' ∘ αᵢ`.
40	* `TruncExpCech.mem_cechCoboundaryUnits_map_iff` — membership transports both ways along a
41	  ring **isomorphism** `β` of the overlap rings (with `αᵢ` isomorphisms too): `u` is a
42	  coboundary iff `β u` is.
43	* `TruncExpCech.cechCoboundaryUnits_comap_unitsMapEquiv` — the subgroup pulls back exactly,
44	  so `Units.map β` induces an isomorphism of the two Čech `Ȟ¹`-of-units quotients
45	  (`cechCoboundaryUnitsQuotEquiv`).
46	-/
47	
48	set_option autoImplicit false
49	
50	universe u v w u' v' w'
51	
52	namespace TruncExpCech
53	
54	variable {A₁ : Type u} {A₂ : Type v} {B : Type w}
55	variable {A₁' : Type u'} {A₂' : Type v'} {B' : Type w'}
56	variable [CommRing A₁] [CommRing A₂] [CommRing B]
57	variable [CommRing A₁'] [CommRing A₂'] [CommRing B']
58	
59	/-- **Coboundaries push forward along an isomorphism of two-chart data.**
60	
61	If `β ∘ ρᵢ = ρᵢ' ∘ αᵢ` for `i = 1, 2` (the two restriction squares commute), then the
62	overlap-ring map `Units.map β` carries the coboundary subgroup of `(ρ₁, ρ₂)` into that of
63	`(ρ₁', ρ₂')`.  Only the two square identities are used — `β` and the `αᵢ` need not be
64	isomorphisms for this direction. -/
65	theorem cechCoboundaryUnits_map_le
66	    (ρ₁ : A₁ →+* B) (ρ₂ : A₂ →+* B) (ρ₁' : A₁' →+* B') (ρ₂' : A₂' →+* B')
67	    (α₁ : A₁ →+* A₁') (α₂ : A₂ →+* A₂') (β : B →+* B')
68	    (h₁ : β.comp ρ₁ = ρ₁'.comp α₁) (h₂ : β.comp ρ₂ = ρ₂'.comp α₂) :
69	    (cechCoboundaryUnits ρ₁ ρ₂).map (Units.map β.toMonoidHom) ≤
70	      cechCoboundaryUnits ρ₁' ρ₂' := by
71	  rintro _ ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
72	  obtain ⟨v₁, v₂, rfl⟩ := mem_cechCoboundaryUnits.mp hu
73	  rw [map_mul]
74	  refine mem_cechCoboundaryUnits.mpr
75	    ⟨Units.map α₁.toMonoidHom v₁, Units.map α₂.toMonoidHom v₂, ?_⟩
76	  congr 1
77	  · ext
78	    have := RingHom.congr_fun h₁ (v₁ : A₁)
79	    simpa [Units.coe_map] using this.symm
80	  · ext
81	    have := RingHom.congr_fun h₂ (v₂ : A₂)
82	    simpa [Units.coe_map] using this.symm
83	
84	/-- The reverse restriction square, obtained from the forward one by conjugating with the
85	inverse isomorphisms.  A helper for the `iff` transport. -/
86	private theorem comp_symm_of_comp
87	    {ρ : A₁ →+* B} {ρ' : A₁' →+* B'} {α : A₁ ≃+* A₁'} {β : B ≃+* B'}
88	    (h : (β : B →+* B').comp ρ = ρ'.comp (α : A₁ →+* A₁')) :
89	    (β.symm : B' →+* B).comp ρ' = ρ.comp (α.symm : A₁' →+* A₁) := by
90	  apply RingHom.ext; intro x
91	  have key := RingHom.congr_fun h (α.symm x)
92	  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.coe_coe, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at key
93	  change β.symm (ρ' x) = ρ (α.symm x)
94	  rw [← key, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
95	
96	/-- **Coboundary membership transports both ways along an isomorphism of two-chart data.**
97	
98	When the vertical maps `α₁, α₂, β` are ring isomorphisms and both restriction squares
99	commute, `u : Bˣ` is a coboundary of `(ρ₁, ρ₂)` iff its image `Units.map β u` is a
100	coboundary of `(ρ₁', ρ₂')`.  This is the form a consumer transporting a *characterisation*
101	of coboundaries (e.g. the ℙ¹ Laurent theory) onto an isomorphic scheme datum uses. -/
102	theorem mem_cechCoboundaryUnits_map_iff
103	    (ρ₁ : A₁ →+* B) (ρ₂ : A₂ →+* B) (ρ₁' : A₁' →+* B') (ρ₂' : A₂' →+* B')
104	    (α₁ : A₁ ≃+* A₁') (α₂ : A₂ ≃+* A₂') (β : B ≃+* B')
105	    (h₁ : (β : B →+* B').comp ρ₁ = ρ₁'.comp (α₁ : A₁ →+* A₁'))
106	    (h₂ : (β : B →+* B').comp ρ₂ = ρ₂'.comp (α₂ : A₂ →+* A₂')) (u : Bˣ) :
107	    Units.map (β : B →+* B').toMonoidHom u ∈ cechCoboundaryUnits ρ₁' ρ₂'
108	      ↔ u ∈ cechCoboundaryUnits ρ₁ ρ₂ := by
109	  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h =>
110	    cechCoboundaryUnits_map_le ρ₁ ρ₂ ρ₁' ρ₂' (α₁ : A₁ →+* A₁') (α₂ : A₂ →+* A₂')
111	      (β : B →+* B') h₁ h₂ (Subgroup.mem_map_of_mem _ h)⟩
112	  have hback := cechCoboundaryUnits_map_le ρ₁' ρ₂' ρ₁ ρ₂
113	    (α₁.symm : A₁' →+* A₁) (α₂.symm : A₂' →+* A₂) (β.symm : B' →+* B)
114	    (comp_symm_of_comp h₁) (comp_symm_of_comp h₂) (Subgroup.mem_map_of_mem _ h)
115	  have he : Units.map (β.symm : B' →+* B).toMonoidHom
116	      (Units.map (β : B →+* B').toMonoidHom u) = u := by ext; simp
117	  rwa [he] at hback
118	
119	end TruncExpCech

6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Tangent.TruncExpCechTransport
7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.LaurentTwoChartCoboundary
8	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.TwoChartCechPicTrivial
9	
10	/-!
11	# The algebra→scheme seam for two-chart ℙ¹ coboundaries
12	
13	The pure-algebra layer (`Picard/LaurentTwoChartCoboundary.lean` and the `Algebra/Laurent*`
14	files) characterises `laurentCoboundaryUnits A`, the coboundary subgroup of the abstract
15	two-chart datum `Polynomial.toLaurent`, `rightChart A` on the Laurent overlap ring
16	`LaurentPolynomial A`.  A scheme consumer of `Scheme.cechPic_eq_one_of_forall_presenting_coboundary`
17	instead holds `Scheme.twoChartCoboundaryUnits V`, the coboundary subgroup of the scheme
18	restriction maps `X.resHom` on `Γ(X, V₀ ⊓ V₁)ˣ`.
19	
20	Both are literally `TruncExpCech.cechCoboundaryUnits` of the respective restriction ring homs
21	(`Scheme.twoChartCoboundaryUnits` unfolds to it by definition, `LaurentTwoChartCoboundary.lean`
22	and `TwoChartCechPicTrivial.lean:71`).  So an **identification of the two data** — ring
23	isomorphisms of the two chart section rings with `A[t]` and of the overlap section ring with
24	`A[T;T⁻¹]`, intertwining the scheme restrictions with `toLaurent`/`rightChart` — transports
25	coboundary membership between them.  This file is that seam: it consumes the identification as
26	hypotheses (the base-changed `ℙ¹_A` two-chart cover that realises them is the remaining scheme
27	build) and hands back the scheme-side `twoChartCoboundaryUnits` membership the criterion wants.
28	
29	Nothing here assumes the identifying isomorphisms are anything in particular, and nothing here
30	uses a new hypothesis on the ring `A`: it is the naturality of `cechCoboundaryUnits`
31	(`TruncExpCech.mem_cechCoboundaryUnits_map_iff`) instantiated at the two Laurent chart maps.
32	
33	## Main declarations
34	
35	* `AlgebraicGeometry.mem_twoChartCoboundaryUnits_iff_laurent` — given the chart identification
36	  data, a scheme overlap unit is in `twoChartCoboundaryUnits V` iff its `A[T;T⁻¹]ˣ` image is in
37	  `laurentCoboundaryUnits A`.
38	-/
39	
40	set_option autoImplicit false
41	
42	universe u
43	
44	open CategoryTheory
45	
46	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
47	
48	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {X : Scheme.{u}} {V : Bool → X.Opens}
49	
50	/-- **The algebra→scheme coboundary seam.**
51	
52	Suppose the two-chart cover `V` of `X` is Laurent-identified over `A`: ring isomorphisms
53	`γ₀ : Γ(X, V false) ≃+* A[t]`, `γ₁ : Γ(X, V true) ≃+* A[t]` of the two chart section rings and
54	`γ₀₁ : Γ(X, V false ⊓ V true) ≃+* A[T;T⁻¹]` of the overlap section ring, intertwining the
55	scheme restrictions `X.resHom` with the two Laurent chart maps
56	(`Polynomial.toLaurent`, `rightChart A`):
57	
58	* `hres₀ : γ₀₁ ∘ resHom(inf_le_left) = toLaurent ∘ γ₀`;
59	* `hres₁ : γ₀₁ ∘ resHom(inf_le_right) = rightChart A ∘ γ₁`.
60	
61	Then a scheme overlap unit `u : Γ(X, V false ⊓ V true)ˣ` is a two-chart coboundary iff its
62	image `Units.map γ₀₁ u : (A[T;T⁻¹])ˣ` is a Laurent coboundary.  Composed with the landed
63	`mem_laurentCoboundaryUnits_iff_general`, this reads the scheme-side coboundary condition off
64	the exponent-zero normal form of the transported Laurent unit — with no new hypothesis. -/
65	theorem mem_twoChartCoboundaryUnits_iff_laurent
66	    (γ₀ : Γ(X, V false) ≃+* Polynomial A) (γ₁ : Γ(X, V true) ≃+* Polynomial A)
67	    (γ₀₁ : Γ(X, V false ⊓ V true) ≃+* LaurentPolynomial A)
68	    (hres₀ : (γ₀₁ : Γ(X, V false ⊓ V true) →+* LaurentPolynomial A).comp
69	        (X.resHom (inf_le_left : V false ⊓ V true ≤ V false))
70	      = (Polynomial.toLaurent : Polynomial A →+* LaurentPolynomial A).comp
71	        (γ₀ : Γ(X, V false) →+* Polynomial A))
72	    (hres₁ : (γ₀₁ : Γ(X, V false ⊓ V true) →+* LaurentPolynomial A).comp
73	        (X.resHom (inf_le_right : V false ⊓ V true ≤ V true))
74	      = (rightChart A).comp (γ₁ : Γ(X, V true) →+* Polynomial A))
75	    (u : Γ(X, V false ⊓ V true)ˣ) :
76	    u ∈ Scheme.twoChartCoboundaryUnits V
77	      ↔ Units.map (γ₀₁ : Γ(X, V false ⊓ V true) →+* LaurentPolynomial A).toMonoidHom u
78	          ∈ laurentCoboundaryUnits A := by
79	  have h :=
80	    TruncExpCech.mem_cechCoboundaryUnits_map_iff
81	      (X.resHom (inf_le_left : V false ⊓ V true ≤ V false))
82	      (X.resHom (inf_le_right : V false ⊓ V true ≤ V true))
83	      (Polynomial.toLaurent : Polynomial A →+* LaurentPolynomial A) (rightChart A)
84	      γ₀ γ₁ γ₀₁ hres₀ hres₁ u
85	  exact h.symm
86	
87	end AlgebraicGeometry

85	/-- **The Čech coboundary subgroup of a two-chart datum**: for restriction
86	homomorphisms `ρ₁ : A₁ →+* B`, `ρ₂ : A₂ →+* B` onto the overlap ring `B`, the subgroup
87	`im(ρ₁ˣ) · im(ρ₂ˣ) ≤ Bˣ` of transition units that are coboundaries of the 2-cover. The
88	quotient `Bˣ ⧸ cechCoboundaryUnits ρ₁ ρ₂` is the two-cover Čech `Ȟ¹` of units — the
89	Čech-cocycle Picard group of the cover. -/
90	def cechCoboundaryUnits (ρ₁ : A₁ →+* B) (ρ₂ : A₂ →+* B) : Subgroup Bˣ :=
91	  (Units.map ρ₁.toMonoidHom).range ⊔ (Units.map ρ₂.toMonoidHom).range
92	
93	/-- Membership in the Čech coboundary subgroup: `u` is a coboundary iff
94	`u = ρ₁ˣ(v₁) · ρ₂ˣ(v₂)` for chart units `vᵢ ∈ Aᵢˣ` (the sign convention with a product
95	rather than a quotient is immaterial: the ranges are subgroups). -/
96	theorem mem_cechCoboundaryUnits {ρ₁ : A₁ →+* B} {ρ₂ : A₂ →+* B} {u : Bˣ} :
97	    u ∈ cechCoboundaryUnits ρ₁ ρ₂
98	      ↔ ∃ (v₁ : A₁ˣ) (v₂ : A₂ˣ),
99	          Units.map ρ₁.toMonoidHom v₁ * Units.map ρ₂.toMonoidHom v₂ = u := by
100	  constructor
101	  · intro h
102	    obtain ⟨y, hy, z, hz, rfl⟩ := Subgroup.mem_sup.mp h
103	    obtain ⟨v₁, rfl⟩ := MonoidHom.mem_range.mp hy
104	    obtain ⟨v₂, rfl⟩ := MonoidHom.mem_range.mp hz
105	    exact ⟨v₁, v₂, rfl⟩
106	  · rintro ⟨v₁, v₂, rfl⟩
107	    exact Subgroup.mem_sup.mpr
108	      ⟨_, MonoidHom.mem_range.mpr ⟨v₁, rfl⟩, _, MonoidHom.mem_range.mpr ⟨v₂, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
109	
110	/-- Chart units from the first chart are coboundaries. -/
111	theorem unitsMap_mem_cechCoboundaryUnits_left (ρ₁ : A₁ →+* B) (ρ₂ : A₂ →+* B)
112	    (v : A₁ˣ) : Units.map ρ₁.toMonoidHom v ∈ cechCoboundaryUnits ρ₁ ρ₂ :=
113	  mem_cechCoboundaryUnits.mpr ⟨v, 1, by simp⟩
114

116	theorem unitsMap_mem_cechCoboundaryUnits_right (ρ₁ : A₁ →+* B) (ρ₂ : A₂ →+* B)
